"""Print the interval report for Kingsholt Theatre's bars.

The till exports land in bars/, one row per sale:

    sale_date,bar,takings_pence

The takings column carries the till's own separators, so the
report reads it through pandas. The report prints one line per
bar, in name order, followed by a totals line:

    <bar>,<sales>,<pence>
    TOTAL,<sales>,<pence>
"""

import glob

import pandas as pd

frames = []
for path in sorted(glob.glob("bars/*.csv")):
    frames.append(pd.read_csv(path, dtype={"takings_pence": str}))

df = pd.concat(frames)
df["pence"] = df["takings_pence"].str.replace(",", "", regex=False).astype(int)
for bar, group in df.groupby("bar"):
    print(f"{bar},{len(group)},{int(group['pence'].sum())}")
print(f"TOTAL,{len(df)},{int(df['pence'].sum())}")
